thread:
sanjay: quick share — ran a cross-region rerank+embed throughput pass on the new 8-bit quantized reranker model. results look... mixed.
sanjay: setup: eu-west (A100-40GB), us-west (H100-80GB), ap-south (V100-old). vector dims=1536, batch sizes 1/8/32 for requests, rerank batch inner loop of 64.
maria: nice. did you include CPU fallback paths?
sanjay: yes — CPU (x86 c5a) baseline with 4 threads, and we tried kernel variants: fused-attn + einsum-optim vs generic matmul path.
lee: what were p95 latencies and throughput?
sanjay: summarized below (tokens/s per GPU for full rerank flow). short table ascii:

  region   | hw    | bs=1 p95(ms) | bs=8 p95(ms) | qps @bs32
  ------------------------------------------------
  eu-west  | A100  | 85           | 45           | 4200
  us-west  | H100  | 60           | 30           | 6800
  ap-south | V100  | 220          | 140          | 900

sanjay: notable: H100 wins (expected) but A100 with fused-attn kernel closed much of gap for bs<=8. V100 is basically unusable for high-throughput rerank.
kevin: did quantization change quality? any regression on our eval set?
sanjay: ran our standard rerank MRR and precision@10 on a 2k eval set. float32->int8 (PTQ) had ~0.8% MRR drop, QAT tuned int8 reduced that to ~0.2%. CPU int8 showed worse latency than GPU int8 (no surprise).
maria: interesting — did you try mixed-precision (fp16 weights + int8 activations)?
sanjay: yep — fp16 weights + int8 activation path gave best tradeoff on A100: p95 down ~12ms vs fp16-only, MRR drop ~0.15%.
lee: kernel choices? which kernels were faster on H100 vs A100 for int8 path?
sanjay: H100 benefited from tensor-core int8 kernels (cut inner loop by ~1.6x). A100 relied on optimized einsum/fused-attn which helped when sequence length < 128.
kevin: regional effects? network + proxy overheads?
sanjay: measured end-to-end with proxying + TLS in front. regional network adds ~6-12ms tail in ap-south vs eu/us. overall throughput at capacity limited by GPU compute, but p95 gets hit by proxy+long-tail in AP region.
bench-bot: automated note: full artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/1910001234/ (summary.csv, perf_profiles/, logs/) :thumbsup:
kevin: can you drop the perf_profiles for the H100 run? want to check kernel traces.
sanjay: uploaded. also leaving the small script we used to sweep batch sizes:

  # sweep script (snippet)
  for bs in 1 8 32; do
    ./run_rerank --model reranker-int8 --vec-dim 1536 --batch $bs --kernel fused || true
  done

maria: next steps: 1) try QAT on the H100 path, 2) test larger dims (2048) to see memory and kernel thrash, 3) run a canary in dedicated eu-west with 2 reserved GPUs.
sanjay: agreed. I'll schedule a quick run tomorrow and ping this thread with updated numbers.
lee: thanks — super actionable. :rocket:
